newsitem.title: UK: Cyprus makes Euromarket debut with $300 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus makes Euromarket debut with $300 mln deal.

text.p: Cyprus on Thursday made its debut in the Eurobond market with a $300 million five-year transaction, lead manager SBC Warburg said.
The size was at the upper end of the $200-$300 million range being touted earlier in the week.
Ioannis Ioannou, head of the external debt section at the Central Bank of Cyprus said at a conference here on Wednesday: "The bond will be for between $200 and $300 million".
Final pricing was due later at a yield spread of 37 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
The bond was issued under a $500 million Euro medium-term note (EMTN) programme recently established by Cyprus.
The proceeds will be used to refinance existing debt and to fund development project.
Ioannou said it was unlikely Cyprus would launch any further bonds this year.
